description: Ten stanza-mapped, checksum-pinned native landscape candidates for unapproved D049 reference comparison.
review_notice: Unapproved landscape candidates for comparison only. Producer self-reviews are recorded separately in art/reviews/; independent exact-checksum visual review is pending for all ten selected versions. S001 v003 excludes conflicting photo 001. Photos 002 and 005 provide broad context only; photos 003, 004 and 006 are documented mismatches and excluded. Photos 007 and 008 are direct river/mountain thematic matches; photo 009 is river context and its unidentified woman is not carried into the candidate; photo 010 supports calf tending but does not show distinct calves. Known producer observations: S002 v004 is selected over v002 (cheek RGB (165,93,51), R-B 114, but forbidden tilak, prayer beads and topknot) and v003 (cheek RGB (206,114,32), R-B 174); selected v004 cheek RGB (181,108,52), R-B 129, remains 9 above the approximate guide; S003 v010 supersedes v009: Krishna’s visible ear, wrists and forehead are bare; both exposed hands show five digits and both feet show five toes. Skin-only medians are Krishna cheek RGB (83,93,127), B-R 44, upper arm RGB (77,88,125), B-R 48, Yashoda cheek RGB (166,89,37), R-B 129, and Nandagopan cheek RGB (166,92,41), R-B 125; the adult readings are 9 and 5 above the approximate <120 guide. The failed v008 usage-limit attempt and v009 findings remain in history; S004 v005 removed Krishna’s previously visible earring and wrist bands; gopika patches measure R-B 125 and 122; S005 retains a small flat yellow earring and collar line; S006 retains small yellow earring and wrist band; S007 v007 has an unmarked forehead and cheek B-R 74; its seated pose is reflected in the final plan, one visible foot shows five toes, and hand-thumb counts remain uncertain because the supporting hand meets the ground and the other rests against the knee; S008 v004 retains a yellow wrist cuff and its rear foot is partly overlapped; S009 v007 shows five toes on both feet but retains an earring and wrist cuff; S010 v011 retains a pale Krishna forehead mark about 4x16 pixels, orange human skin patches (R-B 164–172) and a prominent brown bead necklace on Balarama. These observations are producer findings only. Canonical Sanskrit and IAST remain in content/daskams/d049.json; no vetted English verse translation is supplied. Numbered source commentary is preserved as attributed commentary, not as photo captions. Publishing does not approve artwork; portraits remain paused.

rows.scene: Nandagopan and the cowherd elders confer beside two fallen trees after unexplained calamities at Gokula.
Upananda recommends Vrindavan to the cowherds, indicating the wooded stream valley to the west.
Nandagopan leads the cowherd wagons west as Yashoda and Krishna ride together on a covered cart.
Traveling women smile as Krishna's playful words mingle with the cattle and cart sounds.
Krishna beholds flowering kunda trees and dense emerald-green grass in Vrindavan.
After the cowherds settle, Krishna and the boys explore the forest beside their new homes.
Krishna looks across the winding Yamuna, where swans move among open lotus blossoms.
Krishna beholds Govardhana's high mineral-colored ridges as peacocks call nearby.
Krishna wanders with the cowherd boys as the curved Yamuna appears to follow the forest edge.
Krishna and Balarama tend distinct calves with the cowherd boys in a Vrindavan grove.
